$comment: F1 2011-2013 rules: 25-18-15 points, Q1-Q3 knockout, no refuelling, DRS, KERS as spec ERS, both dry compounds in the race, 640 kg, testing ban. 2010 turns DRS and ERS off in its own patch.

add_options.name: 640 kg with Driver
add_options.summary: Cars must weigh at least 640 kg with the driver and without fuel.
add_options.description: The 2011 to 2013 minimum weight. The chassis figure here leaves out the 95 kg engine the game adds on top.

add_options.name: 11 Dry Sets
add_options.summary: Each driver gets 11 dry sets for the weekend: 6 of the harder and 5 of the softer compound.
add_options.description: The 2011 to 2013 allocation. Sets keep their wear from practice to the race, so a set saved on Friday is a fresh set for Sunday.
